name: Backdooms
tagline: DOOM in the Backrooms, in a GIF. No server.
description:
Open the file and you are in the yellow halls. There is no QR to scan, no jam page, and no server. Close it, come back — your best score lives in the file.

You wake on damp carpet under buzzing lights. The walls go on. Things the colour of dried blood walk toward you. Click or tap to shoot. A six to the chest puts one down. They do not stay gone for long.

On a computer it is WASD and the mouse. Esc hands the pointer back; click again to look. On a phone the left thumb walks, a drag on the right looks, and FIRE sits under the right thumb — or tap the look side.

Send the invite and extra people appear in the same maze as pale figures. You can see them walk. You can shoot them. There is no game server. The room is the link.

An unofficial port of Backdooms by Kuber Mehta. Inspired by DOOM (1993) and The Backrooms. This copy adds the save, the pointer lock, the yellow floor, and the extra bodies in the same halls.
